title: 5760x3840 (5.76K) Open Gate encoding + native 5760x3840 MP4 headers on XAVC HS, XAVC S & XAVC S-I (25p & 23.98p ONLY, dual-core, 260M/290M) (A6700 2.00)
generated_by: build/build_ogfile_a6700.py from the contributed design ogfile57r260_a6700_v1 (work/contrib/a6700_v1.0); compared with ogfile57r300_a6700_v1
format: XAVC HS 4K (HEVC), XAVC S 4K (AVC) and XAVC S-I 4K (AVC intra)

parts.builder: XAVC HS 4K / XAVC S 4K at 23.98p and 25p, normal speed: the descriptors our builder changes
parts.hevc8: HEVC 4:2:0 8-bit rows at 23.98p and 25p (no menu format of this camera that we know of)
parts.s_i: XAVC S-I 4K (codec 0x18) at 23.98p and 25p, normal speed (both the UseCore 2 rows and their UseCore 0 twins)
parts.sq120: rows with input rate 120 (slow and quick recording at 100/120 frames a second coded as 23.98p, 25p or 50p)

status: contributed; its author reports it running on an A6700 2.00 (no logs seen). Converted and checked against the 2.00 files here; emulated by build/run_ogfile_emu_a6700.py and build/emu_mp4_meta.py --build a6700_200. Never run on a camera by us.
